backups_file_name_ck.name: backups_file_name_ck
backups_file_name_ck.value: length(file_name) BETWEEN 10 AND 120 AND file_name NOT GLOB '*[/\]*'

backups_error_ck.name: backups_error_ck
backups_error_ck.value: error_code IS NULL OR (length(error_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 40 AND error_code NOT GLOB '*[^A-Z0-9_]*')

backups_ok_ck.name: backups_ok_ck
backups_ok_ck.value: status <> 'ok' OR (size_bytes IS NOT NULL AND sha256 IS NOT NULL AND finished_at IS NOT NULL)

backups_failed_ck.name: backups_failed_ck
backups_failed_ck.value: status <> 'failed' OR error_code IS NOT NULL

campaign_leads_stop_reason_ck.name: campaign_leads_stop_reason_ck
campaign_leads_stop_reason_ck.value: stop_reason IS NULL OR stop_reason IN ('unsubscribe', 'complaint')

campaign_leads_recipient_ck.name: campaign_leads_recipient_ck
campaign_leads_recipient_ck.value: recipient_email IS NOT NULL OR redacted_at IS NOT NULL OR status IN ('pending', 'excluded')

campaigns_mailbox_ck.name: campaigns_mailbox_ck
campaigns_mailbox_ck.value: status IN ('draft', 'cancelled') OR mailbox_id IS NOT NULL

campaigns_start_ck.name: campaigns_start_ck
campaigns_start_ck.value: status NOT IN ('running', 'paused', 'completed', 'stopped') OR start_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL

country_policies_approval_ck.name: country_policies_approval_ck
country_policies_approval_ck.value: scope = 'demo' OR mode = 'blocked' OR (approval_ref IS NOT NULL AND approved_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL)

domain_registrations_domain_ck.name: domain_registrations_domain_ck
domain_registrations_domain_ck.value: length(domain) BETWEEN 3 AND 253 AND domain = lower(domain)

domain_registrations_ok_ck.name: domain_registrations_ok_ck
domain_registrations_ok_ck.value: status <> 'ok' OR registered_at IS NOT NULL

domain_registrations_error_ck.name: domain_registrations_error_ck
domain_registrations_error_ck.value: last_error IS NULL OR length(last_error) BETWEEN 1 AND 64

import_batches_name_ck.name: import_batches_name_ck
import_batches_name_ck.value: length(filename) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length(source_note) BETWEEN 3 AND 200

import_batches_counts_ck.name: import_batches_counts_ck
import_batches_counts_ck.value: row_count >= 0 AND created_count >= 0 AND duplicate_count >= 0 AND invalid_count >= 0 AND created_count + duplicate_count + invalid_count <= row_count

lead_enrichment_site_domain_ck.name: lead_enrichment_site_domain_ck
lead_enrichment_site_domain_ck.value: site_domain IS NULL OR (length(site_domain) BETWEEN 3 AND 253 AND site_domain = lower(site_domain))

lead_intros_model_ck.name: lead_intros_model_ck
lead_intros_model_ck.value: length(model) BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND model NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9.-]*'

lead_intros_domain_ck.name: lead_intros_domain_ck
lead_intros_domain_ck.value: source_domain IS NULL OR (length(source_domain) BETWEEN 3 AND 253 AND source_domain = lower(source_domain))

leads_website_ck.name: leads_website_ck
leads_website_ck.value: website IS NULL OR length(website) BETWEEN 4 AND 300

mailboxes_connected_ck.name: mailboxes_connected_ck
mailboxes_connected_ck.value: status <> 'connected' OR (address IS NOT NULL AND (provider = 'demo' OR credentials_ref IS NOT NULL))

messages_status_ck.name: messages_status_ck
messages_status_ck.value: (direction = 'out' AND status IN ('queued', 'sending', 'sent', 'failed', 'unknown')) OR (direction = 'in' AND status IN ('received', 'matched', 'unmatched', 'ignored'))

messages_delivery_ck.name: messages_delivery_ck
messages_delivery_ck.value: delivery_status IS NULL OR (direction = 'out' AND delivery_status IN ('bounced_soft', 'bounced_hard'))

messages_classification_ck.name: messages_classification_ck
messages_classification_ck.value: classification IS NULL OR classification IN ('reply', 'bounce', 'auto_reply', 'unsubscribe', 'negative', 'complaint', 'other')

messages_campaign_ck.name: messages_campaign_ck
messages_campaign_ck.value: direction <> 'out' OR purpose <> 'campaign' OR (campaign_id IS NOT NULL AND campaign_lead_id IS NOT NULL AND send_day IS NOT NULL AND idempotency_key IS NOT NULL)

messages_recipient_ck.name: messages_recipient_ck
messages_recipient_ck.value: direction <> 'out' OR to_address IS NOT NULL OR redacted_at IS NOT NULL

messages_subject_variant_ck.name: messages_subject_variant_ck
messages_subject_variant_ck.value: subject_variant IS NULL OR subject_variant IN ('a', 'b')

notifications_kind_ck.name: notifications_kind_ck
notifications_kind_ck.value: length(kind) BETWEEN 3 AND 40 AND kind GLOB '[a-z]*.[a-z]*' AND kind NOT GLOB '*[^a-z._]*'

notifications_url_ck.name: notifications_url_ck
notifications_url_ck.value: length(url) BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND substr(url, 1, 1) = '/' AND substr(url, 1, 2) <> '//'

registry_companies_name_ck.name: registry_companies_name_ck
registry_companies_name_ck.value: length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 300 AND length(name_norm) BETWEEN 1 AND 300 AND (trading_name IS NULL OR length(trading_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 300)

registry_companies_text_ck.name: registry_companies_text_ck
registry_companies_text_ck.value: (postcode IS NULL OR length(postcode) <= 16) AND (locality IS NULL OR length(locality) <= 120) AND (locality_norm IS NULL OR length(locality_norm) <= 120) AND (address_line IS NULL OR length(address_line) <= 200) AND (registry_status IS NULL OR length(registry_status) <= 40) AND (category_key IS NULL OR length(category_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 64)

registry_companies_score_ck.name: registry_companies_score_ck
registry_companies_score_ck.value: match_score IS NULL OR (match_score >= 0 AND match_score <= 1)

registry_companies_place_ck.name: registry_companies_place_ck
registry_companies_place_ck.value: matched_place_id IS NULL OR match_status IN ('matched', 'manual')

registry_companies_reason_ck.name: registry_companies_reason_ck
registry_companies_reason_ck.value: match_reason IS NULL OR (length(match_reason) BETWEEN 1 AND 40 AND match_reason NOT GLOB '*[^a-z_]*')

registry_runs_codes_ck.name: registry_runs_codes_ck
registry_runs_codes_ck.value: json_valid(activity_codes) AND json_type(activity_codes) = 'array' AND json_array_length(activity_codes) BETWEEN 1 AND 20

registry_runs_window_ck.name: registry_runs_window_ck
registry_runs_window_ck.value: date(window_from) IS window_from AND date(window_to) IS window_to AND window_from <= window_to

registry_runs_locality_ck.name: registry_runs_locality_ck
registry_runs_locality_ck.value: locality IS NULL OR length(locality) BETWEEN 1 AND 80

registry_runs_counts_ck.name: registry_runs_counts_ck
registry_runs_counts_ck.value: fetched_count >= 0 AND new_count >= 0 AND matched_count >= 0 AND unmatched_count >= 0 AND pending_count >= 0

registry_runs_error_ck.name: registry_runs_error_ck
registry_runs_error_ck.value: error_code IS NULL OR (length(error_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 40 AND error_code NOT GLOB '*[^A-Z0-9_]*')

registry_runs_failed_ck.name: registry_runs_failed_ck
registry_runs_failed_ck.value: status <> 'failed' OR error_code IS NOT NULL

scan_schedules_json_ck.name: scan_schedules_json_ck
scan_schedules_json_ck.value: json_valid(category_set_ids) AND json_type(category_set_ids) = 'array' AND json_valid(custom_keywords) AND json_type(custom_keywords) = 'array'

scan_schedules_ack_ck.name: scan_schedules_ack_ck
scan_schedules_ack_ck.value: (ack_max_usd IS NULL AND ack_at IS NULL) OR (ack_max_usd IS NOT NULL AND ack_max_usd >= 0 AND ack_at IS NOT NULL)

scan_schedules_outcome_ck.name: scan_schedules_outcome_ck
scan_schedules_outcome_ck.value: last_outcome IS NULL OR last_outcome IN ('started', 'skipped', 'completed', 'failed')

scan_schedules_skip_code_ck.name: scan_schedules_skip_code_ck
scan_schedules_skip_code_ck.value: last_skip_code IS NULL OR (length(last_skip_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 40 AND last_skip_code NOT GLOB '*[^A-Z0-9_]*')

scans_schedule_slot_ck.name: scans_schedule_slot_ck
scans_schedule_slot_ck.value: (origin = 'manual' AND schedule_id IS NULL AND schedule_slot IS NULL) OR (origin = 'schedule' AND schedule_slot IS NOT NULL)

scans_pause_code_ck.name: scans_pause_code_ck
scans_pause_code_ck.value: pause_code IS NULL OR (length(pause_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 40 AND pause_code NOT GLOB '*[^A-Z0-9_]*')

suppressions_key_ck.name: suppressions_key_ck
suppressions_key_ck.value: scope = 'domain' OR (email_hash IS NOT NULL AND hash_alg IS NOT NULL)

suppressions_lift_ck.name: suppressions_lift_ck
suppressions_lift_ck.value: lifted_at IS NULL OR lifted_reason IS NOT NULL

templates_subject_b_ck.name: templates_subject_b_ck
templates_subject_b_ck.value: subject_b IS NULL OR length(subject_b) BETWEEN 1 AND 500
